headline: Quiet Saturday; recent safety news slowly fades
body: No scored events today. Earlier announcements faded a little, easing Descendants and several others by a few hundredths. Horizon Balance is -3.58, near its lowest of the month. Enslaved God leads at 37.38; Conquerors sits fourth at 23.90.
movers_note: Only small drifts as earlier news faded: Descendants -0.08 and Conquerors -0.07.
